what: CRITICAL: When something doesn't work, DEBUG FIRST before abandoning the approach. Add logging, check the actual data, trace the execution. Don't assume a feature "doesn't work" — investigate WHY. In this session: assumed PostToolUse doesn't fire for MCP tools, went through 5 different approaches, removed working code, wasted hours. The actual fix was one jq path change (tool_response is an array, not a string). Two minutes of debug logging would have found it immediately. NEVER abandon an approach without first adding debug logging and checking the actual input/output.
why: User called out pattern of abandoning approaches without debugging. Cost: hours of wasted work, 5 rewrites of the same code, broken functionality. Fix: debug logging first, always.
